title: cinna-agent.json
description: Definitional metadata for a locally built agent. Lives at the agent folder root and travels unchanged into a cloud agent workspace and into bundle revisions. Unknown keys are preserved for forward compatibility.

allOf.$comment: Identity is required of every folder scaffolded at contract 1.0.0 or later, and tolerated as absent in exactly one case: a legacy folder, which carries the integer schema_version and neither contract_version nor id. Such a folder must still parse - it is read, reported, and re-stamped - which is why contract_version and id are not in the top-level `required`. Any other manifest needs both. This encodes the same rule as the desktop's checkIdentity() and the CHANGELOG's Compatibility table; if you change one, change all three.

then.$comment: Legacy folder: read it, warn, ask for a re-stamp.

contract_version.description: Version of the folder contract this agent was scaffolded against, and the compatibility gate: a tool whose contract major is older than this must refuse to operate the folder. Required of every folder except a legacy one (see the top-level allOf).

id.description: Stable identity of this agent, written once at scaffold and never rewritten. Survives folder moves and slug renames; preserved through cloud import as the agent's local origin. Required of every folder except a legacy one (see the top-level allOf).

schema_version.description: Legacy manifest version. A manifest that carries it, and neither contract_version nor id, is a pre-1.0.0 folder: it still parses, and a tool should re-stamp it rather than reject it. It is no longer the compatibility gate and nothing should branch on its value.

kit_version.description: Version of the kit that scaffolded this agent. Informational only - never a gate.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp written by the scaffolder. Informational.

slug.description: Folder name and cloud reference. Must equal the agent folder's name.

description.description: One sentence describing what the agent does. Feeds agent cards, the A2A card and router-trigger generation.

example_prompts.description: Ready-to-send task suggestions AND a first-class routing input. At least one is required for a cloud-ready agent.

router_trigger_prompt.description: One capability-verb sentence used only by the routing classifier. Describes when to route here, never how to behave.

prompts.description: Paths, relative to the agent root, of the three document-backed prompts.

runtime.description: How this agent should be run by a host that offers a choice. Absent means the host's default runtime. Never contains a secret: credential is a reference, not a key.

model.description: Model identifier as the host names it. Seeds the cloud's per-mode model override at import.

complexity.description: How hard this agent's work is, as a portable alternative to a concrete model id: the host resolves it against the models the chosen credential actually offers. Mutually exclusive with `model`. Added in contract 1.1.0; a host that does not understand it falls back to `model`.

credential.description: Reference to the AI credential to run on: a credential type, or the name of a credential configured in the host. NEVER a key, token or secret value.

permissions.description: Host-specific permission profile for the agent's own tools. Interpreted by the host that wrote it; unknown keys are preserved.

status_refresh_command.description: Shell command, or a /run:<name> reference into docs/CLI_COMMANDS.yaml, executed before the platform reads STATUS.md.

credentials.description: Credential slots the agent needs. Never contains secret values.

env_prefix.description: Prefix of the local .env variable names for this slot. Variable name is <env_prefix><FIELD in upper case>.

fields.description: Field names of the credential payload, as the platform names them.

schedules.description: Unattended runs. Declared locally, created on the platform at import time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Local-only metadata used to render the cron description at import.

prompt.description: Required for static_prompt: the message sent to start the run.

command.description: Required for script_trigger: the shell command whose non-OK output starts a session.

handovers.description: Other agents this one may delegate to. Targets are slugs of sibling agents.

features.description: Cloud-only capabilities the agent expects once imported. Ignored locally.

publications.description: One entry per Cinna instance this agent was published to. Written only by a publish/import step. An update resolves the entry whose platform_url matches the instance it runs against.

platform_url.description: Origin of the instance, e.g. https://acme.opencinna.io.

agent_id.description: Id of the agent created on that instance.

workspace.description: Account workspace the CLI pushed from, relative to the workshop root, e.g. Cloud/acme.opencinna.io. Absent when the desktop published directly through the account API.

contract_version.description: Contract version the folder was pushed with.

content_hash.description: Hash of the exported tree at the last push (cloud_import_excludes applied). A mismatch against the current export means the instance is behind.

cloud.description: DEPRECATED, replaced by publications[]. Still accepted so a folder written before contract 1.0.0 parses; migrate it into publications[] on the next write.
